subject: Mathematics
shortDescription: Ramagya School (Noida Extension) is hiring a TGT Mathematics educator for secondary students. Responsibilities include delivering CBSE-aligned instruction, administering assessments, and fostering a disciplined environment.
description:
*ROLE PURPOSE*
The TGT Mathematics educator at *Ramagya School (Noida Extension)* is responsible for delivering structured, CBSE-aligned mathematics instruction to secondary students while ensuring measurable academic progress, rigorous assessment practices, and comprehensive student development. The role requires designing and executing evidence-based lessons, administering formative and summative assessments, maintaining detailed performance records, implementing targeted intervention strategies, and fostering a disciplined learning environment that supports both academic excellence and co-curricular engagement.

*KEY RESPONSIBILITIES-*
1. Design and deliver structured mathematics lessons aligned to CBSE curriculum standards with documented learning objectives and demonstrated conceptual clarity
2. Administer formative and summative assessments using varied assessment tools and maintain systematic records of student performance with quantifiable progress tracking
3. Identify individual student learning gaps through diagnostic assessments and implement targeted intervention strategies with documented evidence of progress
4. Maintain organized, accessible records of student performance, attendance, developmental feedback, and assessment data using school ERP/HRMS systems
5. Execute classroom management protocols that result in measurable improvements in student focus, on-task behavior, and reduction in disciplinary incidents
6. Communicate structurally with parents through data-driven progress reports, documented feedback sessions, and evidence-based parent engagement mechanisms
7. Integrate teaching aids, digital resources, and technology-enabled instruction to enhance conceptual clarity and student engagement
8. Contribute actively to institutional co-curricular programs including mathematics clubs, inter-school competitions, workshops, and special projects
9. Maintain proficiency in school ERP/HRMS ecosystem for attendance marking, assessment data entry, report generation, and administrative compliance
10. Participate in ongoing professional development programs and curriculum updates to align with evolving pedagogical standards and subject matter expertise
11. Collaborate with school leadership on curriculum implementation, assessment moderation, and institutional academic initiatives

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS
1. Percentage of students demonstrating measurable progress in mathematics learning outcomes as evidenced by formative assessments (minimum 80% achievement target)
2. Completion of prescribed CBSE curriculum within stipulated academic calendar with documented lesson plans and coverage records
3. Quality of assessment tools and rubrics with demonstrated alignment to learning objectives and CBSE standards
4. Reduction in classroom disciplinary incidents with documented evidence of improved student focus and on-task behavior
5. Frequency and quality of parent communication with documented parent satisfaction feedback scores
6. Timely completion of student performance records, attendance reports, and assessment data entry in ERP/HRMS system
7. Active participation and outcomes in co-curricular mathematics programs and inter-school competitions
8. Completion of mandated professional development hours aligned with institutional requirements
9. Quality of targeted intervention strategies implemented for identified learning gaps with documented student progress

*QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE-*
Minimum: Bachelor's degree in Mathematics or Science (with Mathematics as a major/minor); CTET or UPTET certification.
Preferred: Master's degree in Mathematics; B.Ed from recognized institution; additional certification in digital teaching methodologies or assessment practices
Min Experience: *3-8 yrs*

description:
*Job Purpose*

The Vice Principal supports the Principal in providing strategic, academic, and administrative leadership to ensure the smooth functioning of the school. The role focuses on maintaining high academic standards, promoting student well-being, ensuring regulatory compliance, strengthening teacher performance, and fostering a safe, disciplined, and inclusive learning environment.

*Key Responsibilities*

*1. Academic Leadership*

* Assist the Principal in planning and implementing the school's academic vision and objectives.
* Monitor curriculum delivery and ensure compliance with CBSE/State Board guidelines.
* Conduct regular classroom observations and provide constructive feedback to teachers.
* Review lesson plans, assessments, and student learning outcomes.
* Analyse examination results and develop strategies for continuous academic improvement.
* Lead teacher mentoring, coaching, and professional development initiatives.

*2. School Administration*

* Oversee the day-to-day operations of the school.
* Prepare academic calendars, timetables, examination schedules, and duty rosters.
* Ensure smooth coordination among academic and administrative departments.
* Supervise school events, assemblies, functions, and co-curricular activities.
* Support admissions, orientation programmes, and enrolment planning.

*3. Staff Management*

* Supervise teaching and non-teaching staff.
* Conduct performance evaluations and recommend training needs.
* Promote accountability, teamwork, and professional ethics.
* Assist in recruitment, onboarding, and induction of new employees.

*4. Student Welfare & Discipline*

* Maintain a safe, disciplined, and child-friendly school environment.
* Address student behavioural concerns through counselling and restorative practices.
* Ensure implementation of school discipline policies, anti-bullying measures, and student safety protocols.
* Promote student leadership, well-being, and holistic development.
* Ensure compliance with child protection requirements, including POCSO guidelines.

*5. Parent & Community Engagement*

* Build positive relationships with parents and guardians.
* Address parent concerns professionally and promptly.
* Organise Parent-Teacher Meetings (PTMs) and parent engagement initiatives.
* Represent the school during inspections, community programmes, and official meetings.

*6. Compliance & Quality Assurance*

* Ensure adherence to CBSE/State Board, RTE Act, NEP 2020, and other statutory requirements.
* Maintain academic and administrative records.
* Support school audits, inspections, accreditation processes, and documentation.
* Monitor implementation of school policies, SOPs, and safety procedures.

*7. Strategic Support*

* Assist the Principal in institutional planning and policy implementation.
* Prepare reports, presentations, and performance dashboards.
* Act as the Principal in their absence and ensure continuity of school operations.

*Qualifications*

* Master's Degree in any discipline (Mandatory)
* B.Ed. (Mandatory)
* M.Ed. (Preferred)
* Certification or training in Educational Leadership/School Administration (Preferred)

*Experience*

* Minimum *8–12 years* of teaching experience.
* At least *3–5 years* in an academic leadership role such as Academic Coordinator, Headmistress, Senior Coordinator, or Vice Principal.
* Experience in *CBSE-affiliated schools* preferred.

description:
*Job Title: TGT Social Science (Master’s in Economics)*

*The Heritage School, Vasant Kunj, New Delhi*
*Employment Type:* Full-time
*Department:* Social Science

Job Description

The Heritage School, Vasant Kunj, invites applications from qualified and dedicated educators for the position of Trained Graduate Teacher (TGT) – Social Science, with a postgraduate qualification in Economics.

The successful candidate will be responsible for delivering engaging, curriculum-aligned lessons, fostering critical thinking and developing students’ understanding of economic, historical, geographical and political concepts, as applicable to the assigned classes.

Key Responsibilities

* Plan and deliver Social Science lessons in accordance with the CBSE curriculum and NCERT learning objectives.
* Explain economic concepts using real-world examples, case studies, current affairs and data interpretation.
* Develop students’ analytical thinking, research skills, civic awareness and problem-solving abilities.
* Use inquiry-based, experiential and interdisciplinary teaching strategies to enhance student engagement.
* Prepare lesson plans, worksheets, assignments, question papers and assessment materials.
* Assess learning outcomes, maintain academic records and provide constructive feedback.
* Support differentiated learning and address the diverse academic needs of students.
* Integrate appropriate digital resources, maps, graphs and other teaching-learning materials.
* Participate in departmental meetings, parent interactions, school activities and professional development programmes.
* Maintain a safe, inclusive and positive classroom environment.

Essential Qualifications

* *Master’s degree in Economics*, as required for this vacancy.
* Bachelor’s degree with the relevant subject combination required for TGT Social Science under the applicable recruitment rules.
* B.Ed. from a recognised institution, where prescribed.
* CTET Paper II qualification, where applicable under the relevant recruitment requirements.
* Candidates must satisfy the applicable CBSE, NCTE and Delhi school-teacher eligibility norms.

Required Skills and Competencies

* Strong subject knowledge in Economics and Social Science.
* Excellent communication and classroom facilitation skills.
* Ability to connect academic concepts with real-world developments.
* Competence in lesson planning, assessment design and student progress monitoring.
* Familiarity with CBSE/NCERT curriculum expectations and competency-based learning.
* Ability to promote critical thinking, collaboration and independent learning.

*Experience*

Relevant teaching experience in Social Science or Economics at the middle or secondary school level is preferred.

Work Location

The Heritage School, Vasant Kunj, New Delhi.

Interested candidates may apply through Indeedor mail us on *careers.vk@theheritageschool.in* with an updated CV detailing their academic qualifications, teaching experience and relevant subject expertise.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

StWillibrord Educational Trust is seeking an experienced, proactive Headmistress for its prestigious school campus in Mumbai, Maharashtra.

Key Responsibilities:
* Section Leadership: Direct academic and administrative functions of the school section (Primary/Middle wing), ensuring adherence to ICSE / board standards.

* Student Wellbeing & Discipline: Supervise student attendance, code of conduct, counseling support, and pastoral care programs.
* Event & Activity Planning: Coordinate annual days, cultural celebrations, science fairs, sports tournaments, and literary competitions.
* Parent Communication: Conduct parent-teacher meetings, resolve parent feedback empathetically, and foster community trust.
* Examination & Reporting: Supervise the scheduling, conduct, and grading of periodic assessments and term-end examinations.

* Master's or Bachelor's degree with B.Ed. from an NCTE-recognized institution.
* Minimum 7 to 10 years of successful teaching experience with at least 3 years in academic coordination, supervisory, or headmistress roles in a reputed school.
* Outstanding leadership, conflict-resolution, and organizational skills.
* Exceptional verbal and written English communication.

description:
SUBJECTS: Science Teacher CBSE (TGT)

MUST HAVE B.ED

The roles and responsibilities of a school teacher can vary depending on grade level, subject, and school policies, but here are some common core duties and expectations:

*Instructional Planning*: Teachers are responsible for designing and delivering effective lesson plans that align with curriculum standards. They must adapt their teaching methods to accommodate diverse learning styles and abilities.

*Classroom Management*: Maintaining a positive and orderly classroom environment is crucial. Teachers must establish rules and expectations, manage student behavior, and address any disruptions that may arise.

*Assessment and Evaluation*: Teachers assess student performance through various means such as tests, quizzes, projects, and assignments. They analyze and use assessment data to track student progress and adjust instruction as needed.

*Curriculum Development*: In addition to lesson planning, teachers may have a role in developing or revising curriculum materials to meet the needs of their students and keep up with educational standards.

*Individualized Instruction*: Recognizing that students have different learning needs, teachers should provide additional support or challenges as required. This includes working with students who have special needs or require differentiated instruction.

*Communication*: Teachers communicate regularly with students, parents, and colleagues. They provide feedback on student progress, discuss concerns, and attend parent-teacher conferences and meetings.

*Professional Development*: Continuous learning is essential for teachers. They should engage in ongoing professional development to stay current with educational trends, teaching methods, and subject matter.

*Supervision and Safety*: Ensuring the safety and well-being of students is a top priority. Teachers must supervise students in and outside of the classroom and follow safety protocols.

*Collaboration*: Teachers often work as part of a team, collaborating with other educators, specialists, and support staff to address the diverse needs of their students.

*Counseling and Support*: Teachers sometimes act as mentors and provide emotional support to students who may be facing challenges at home or in their personal lives.

*Record-Keeping*: Maintaining accurate records of student attendance, grades, and other relevant information is essential for monitoring progress and complying with administrative requirements.

*Professional Ethics*: Teachers are expected to adhere to a code of professional ethics, which includes respecting student confidentiality, maintaining appropriate boundaries, and upholding the values of fairness and equity in their teaching practices.

*Community Involvement*: Engaging with the local community and participating in school events, clubs, or extracurricular activities can be part of a teacher's responsibilities.

*Technology Integration*: In today's digital age, teachers are often expected to incorporate technology into their teaching methods and use it for communication and instructional purposes.

*Cultural Sensitivity*: Being aware of and respecting cultural and diversity issues in the classroom is crucial for creating an inclusive learning environment.

title: Consultant Trainer
description:
Consultant Trainer – Foundational Learning, English Language, Pedagogy & Technology
About Kotak Education Foundation
Kotak Education Foundation (KEF) works towards improving the quality of education by strengthening teachers, school leaders and education systems.
We are looking for experienced Consultant Trainers to deliver high-quality teacher training programmes across Maharashtra, Andhra Pradesh and Gujarat.

Role Purpose
The Consultant Trainer will be responsible for facilitating high-quality, engaging and practice-oriented training programmes for teachers and education stakeholders across the assigned state.
The ideal candidate should have a strong foundation in teacher education and classroom pedagogy, with relevant experience in at least one of the following domains:
Foundational Literacy and Numeracy (FLN)
English Language Learning and Acquisition
Pedagogy
Use of Technology in Education
The role also requires the ability to contextualise training to the language, curriculum and classroom realities of the respective state.

Key Responsibilities
1. Teacher Training & Facilitation
Deliver face-to-face and, where required, virtual training programmes for teachers and education stakeholders.
Facilitate training sessions using participatory, experiential and activity-based methodologies.
Conduct demonstrations, modelling sessions, practice activities, teach-backs and reflection sessions.
Create an environment that encourages teacher participation, discussion and application.
Adapt facilitation approaches based on participant profiles, school contexts and learning needs.
Support teachers in translating training concepts into classroom practice.
2. Domain Expertise
The Consultant Trainer should have demonstrated experience in at least one of the following domains:
A. Foundational Literacy and Numeracy (FLN)
Foundational literacy and numeracy concepts and classroom practices.
Early-grade language and mathematics pedagogy.
Play-based, activity-based and experiential approaches.
Reading, writing, oral language and foundational mathematics.
Classroom assessment and identification of learning gaps.
Familiarity with NIPUN Bharat / foundational learning objectives will be an advantage.
B. English Language Learning & Acquisition
English language teaching and language acquisition.
Teaching English in multilingual classroom contexts.
Listening, Speaking, Reading and Writing (LSRW).
Communicative language teaching and learner-centred pedagogy.
Vocabulary, grammar and reading development.
Understanding of language acquisition principles.
Familiarity with CEFR or other language proficiency frameworks will be an advantage.
C. Pedagogy
Strong understanding of effective teaching-learning practices.
Learner-centred and activity-based pedagogy.
Experiential and inquiry-based learning.
Differentiated instruction and inclusive classroom practices.
Lesson planning, classroom management and assessment.
Ability to translate pedagogical theories into practical classroom strategies.
D. Use of Technology in Education
Integration of technology into teaching and learning.
Digital pedagogy and technology-enabled classroom practices.
Use of digital tools and platforms for teaching, learning and assessment.
Ability to demonstrate technology tools to teachers with varying levels of digital proficiency.
Familiarity with AI-enabled educational tools will be an advantage.
3. Training Preparation & Design
Study training manuals, facilitator guides, presentations and supporting resources before delivery.
Prepare for training through dry runs, practice and self-learning.
Provide feedback on training materials based on field experience.
Adapt examples and activities to local classroom contexts without compromising programme objectives.
Support the CCT team in developing or refining training resources when required.
4. Field Implementation
Travel extensively within the assigned state to conduct teacher training programmes.
Work across urban, semi-urban and rural locations as required.
Coordinate with project teams, school leaders and field teams to ensure smooth training delivery.
Maintain professional conduct and represent KEF appropriately at partner and beneficiary locations.
Demonstrate flexibility regarding training locations, schedules and participant groups.
5. Documentation & Quality Assurance
Maintain accurate records of trainings conducted, participant attendance and training-related data.
Complete training reports and feedback documentation within stipulated timelines.
Collect and communicate field-level observations, challenges and success stories.
Use participant feedback and observation data to improve subsequent training delivery.
Adhere to KEF's training quality standards and processes.

Minimum Qualifications & Experience
Essential Qualifications
B.Ed. is mandatory.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Education, English, Psychology, Mathematics or a related discipline will be preferred.
Additional qualifications/certifications in teacher training, instructional design, FLN, English language teaching or educational technology will be an advantage.
Experience
Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in classroom teaching, teacher training, academic mentoring or a related education role.
Demonstrated experience in at least ONE of the following domains is mandatory:
Foundational Literacy and Numeracy (FLN)
English Language Learning and Acquisition
Pedagogy
Use of Technology in Education
Experience in more than one of these domains will be an advantage.
Experience facilitating training for teachers is preferred.
Candidates with a combination of classroom teaching and teacher training experience will be preferred.

Language Requirements
Fluency in relevant state language is mandatory.
The candidate must be comfortable conducting teacher training, explaining concepts, facilitating discussions and responding to participant questions in the local language.

Geography-Specific Requirements
Maharashtra
Mandatory:
B.Ed.
Minimum 5 years relevant experience.
Experience in at least one of the four domains: FLN, English Language Learning & Acquisition, Pedagogy or Use of Technology.
Fluency in Marathi and English.
Willingness to travel extensively across Maharashtra.
Preferred: Experience with government schools, Marathi-medium/multilingual classrooms, NIPUN Bharat/FLN initiatives, SCERT/DIET or education department programmes.

*About Us*

Ahmedabad International School (AIS) was founded 25 years ago, on the belief that self-learning leads to lifelong learning. The AIS community inculcates a love for learning, fosters social and emotional acuity, develops responsible global citizens, and builds a strong academic foundation.

AIS is an IB World School where students fall in love with learning, discover their passions, and prepare for the world beyond the classroom. AIS is over 1600 students strong across K-12 with some of the finest placements in the world. AIS alumni are represented at Stanford, Columbia, Cornell, Brown, Carnegie Mellon, Oxford, Cambridge, Imperial, St. Andrews, IITs, NLUs, and many more distinguished universities.

Our goal is to build a learning community like no other - one where students and teachers feel empowered to do their best work. AIS teachers are critically reflective practitioners who wear multiple hats - facilitators, mentors, learners, friends, researchers, and collaborators. They ask and ponder over hard questions like ‘what is the role of a teacher when information is available at a click’, ‘how do we design learning that is challenging and significant’, and much more.

*Our Team*

Faculty at AIS are exceptional. They create and model a high-quality learning environment. Our team is diverse and comes from some of the finest institutions in the world - Stanford, Brown, IITs, McKinsey, Teach for India, and varied international schools. AIS teachers are not the “sage on the stage” but rather the “guide by the side”. They are designers of learning, provide intellectual challenge, guide student curiosity, and co-construct learning with students. To ensure that we recruit and retain the strongest teachers, we strongly emphasize continuous teacher professional development and well-being.

description:
VIDYĀMṚTNurturing Spiritually Grounded Future LeadersJob Description: Project Coordinator

*Position:* Project Coordinator
*Organisation:* Vidyāmṛt – Micro School
*Location:* Bengaluru, Karnataka
*Employment Type:* Full-time
*Reporting To:* Founder / School Leadership
*Working Days:* Monday to Friday, with occasional weekend commitments for school events and parent engagement

1. About Vidyāmṛt

Vidyāmṛt is a progressive micro-school that integrates academic excellence, experiential learning, character development, and Krishna consciousness to nurture spiritually grounded future leaders.

Our educational approach combines rigorous academics with Sādācāra (values and good conduct), Bhakti (devotional practices), design thinking, innovation, technology, and hands-on learning.

We are looking for a highly organised, proactive, and responsible Project Coordinator who can ensure the smooth execution of school operations, academic programmes, student activities, parent communication, and institutional initiatives.

The ideal candidate will be a self-starter who enjoys working in a dynamic educational environment and is passionate about contributing to the holistic development of children.

2. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Project Planning and Execution

* Plan, coordinate, and monitor school projects, programmes, events, and special initiatives.
* Prepare project plans, activity schedules, timelines, and execution checklists.
* Coordinate with teachers, facilitators, vendors, parents, and external partners to ensure timely completion of tasks.
* Track project milestones, identify potential delays, and proactively resolve operational challenges.
* Maintain project documentation, meeting notes, action items, and progress reports.
* Ensure that all initiatives are executed within the agreed timelines and budgets.

B. Academic Programme Coordination

* Coordinate academic calendars, timetables, assessments, examinations, and student presentations.
* Ensure teachers have the required learning materials, resources, and logistical support.
* Track completion of planned academic activities and follow up on pending tasks.
* Coordinate interdisciplinary projects, design challenges, STEAM activities, AI sessions, and experiential learning programmes.
* Maintain records of student attendance, academic progress, assignments, and assessment schedules.
* Support the preparation and timely distribution of student report cards and progress reports.
* Coordinate the implementation of Vidyāmṛt's three-dimensional student development framework:
* *Academic Rigour* – Knowledge, skills, assignments, examinations, projects, and presentations.
* *Sādācāra* – Character, discipline, responsibility, habits, and conduct.
* *Bhakti* – Participation in kirtan, japa, kartals, śloka recitation, and other devotional activities.

C. Student Activities and Event Management

* Coordinate daily activities, workshops, competitions, celebrations, field visits, and special programmes.
* Organise events such as Janmāṣṭamī celebrations, Gītā Jayantī, student exhibitions, parent meetings, and annual presentations.
* Manage event schedules, resource requirements, venue arrangements, and activity materials.
* Coordinate photography, videography, student documentation, and event reports.
* Ensure activities are conducted safely, smoothly, and in alignment with Vidyāmṛt's educational philosophy.
* Maintain an annual calendar of academic, cultural, devotional, and extracurricular activities.

D. Parent Communication and Engagement

* Serve as a coordination point for routine parent communication.
* Share timely updates regarding schedules, examinations, holidays, events, assignments, and school announcements.
* Coordinate parent-teacher meetings and ensure that follow-up actions are completed.
* Respond professionally to routine parent queries and escalate sensitive or complex concerns to the school leadership.
* Support admissions-related communication, prospective parent interactions, school visits, and orientation sessions.
* Help build a positive and collaborative relationship between parents and the school.

E. School Operations and Administration

* Maintain accurate records of attendance, schedules, resources, student information, and operational activities.
* Coordinate procurement of stationery, books, educational materials, and activity supplies.
* Monitor inventory and ensure that classrooms, learning spaces, and activity areas are adequately equipped.
* Coordinate transportation schedules and communicate operational changes to parents when required.
* Liaise with vendors, service providers, and external partners.
* Ensure that administrative processes are documented and followed consistently.
* Support compliance with school policies, student safety procedures, and operational protocols.

F. Admissions and Institutional Growth

* Support the admissions process by coordinating enquiries, follow-ups, school visits, and parent interactions.
* Maintain an organised database of prospective parents and admission status.
* Assist with the planning and execution of outreach activities in target neighbourhoods.
* Coordinate open houses, introductory sessions, workshops, and community engagement programmes.
* Track admissions-related activities and provide regular updates to the school leadership.
* Support the development and implementation of systems required as Vidyāmṛt expands.

G. Digital Tools, Documentation, and Reporting

* Use digital tools such as Google Workspace, spreadsheets, forms, calendars, and project management platforms to coordinate activities.
* Maintain structured trackers for tasks, deadlines, responsibilities, and project status.
* Prepare weekly progress reports covering completed tasks, pending actions, challenges, and upcoming priorities.
* Use AI tools responsibly to improve productivity, documentation, communication, and workflow efficiency.
* Develop standard operating procedures, templates, and checklists to improve operational consistency.
* Ensure that student and parent information is handled confidentially and securely.

H. Culture and Values Alignment

* Understand and respect Vidyāmṛt's educational philosophy and Krishna-conscious environment.
* Help ensure that school programmes reflect the principles of Sādācāra, Bhakti, responsibility, compassion, and service.
* Demonstrate punctuality, integrity, accountability, and a service-oriented attitude.
* Encourage a positive, respectful, and disciplined working environment.
* Approach responsibilities with care, humility, initiative, and a commitment to continuous improvement.

3. Required Qualifications and Experience

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline. Qualifications in education, management, business administration, or project management are preferred.
* 2–5 years of experience in project coordination, school administration, programme management, operations, or a related role.
* Experience working in a school, educational institution, startup, or purpose-driven organisation is desirable.
* Strong organisational and multitasking abilities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Proficiency in Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, spreadsheets, and digital communication tools.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritise tasks, and meet deadlines.
* Familiarity with AI tools and digital productivity platforms is an advantage.

4. Essential Competencies

The ideal candidate should demonstrate:

* *Ownership:* Takes responsibility for tasks from initiation to completion.
* *Organisation:* Maintains clear plans, schedules, records, and documentation.
* *Execution:* Converts ideas and instructions into timely, measurable outcomes.
* *Communication:* Communicates clearly, respectfully, and proactively.
* *Problem-solving:* Identifies challenges early and proposes practical solutions.
* *Attention to Detail:* Ensures accuracy in schedules, records, communications, and deliverables.
* *Adaptability:* Works effectively in a growing organisation where priorities may evolve.
* *Technology Orientation:* Uses digital tools and AI to improve efficiency.
* *Interpersonal Skills:* Works harmoniously with children, parents, teachers, and external stakeholders.
* *Values Alignment:* Demonstrates integrity, discipline, responsibility, and a willingness to serve.

5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be assessed against measurable outcomes, including:

AreaPerformance IndicatorProject ExecutionPercentage of assigned projects completed within agreed timelinesTask ManagementTimely completion and follow-up of assigned action itemsAcademic CoordinationAccuracy and timeliness of calendars, schedules, and assessment coordinationParent CommunicationTimely dissemination of information and closure of routine queriesEvent ManagementSmooth execution of planned events within timelines and budgetsDocumentationAccuracy, completeness, and accessibility of school recordsAdmissions SupportTimely follow-up of enquiries and coordination of school visitsOperational EfficiencyReduction in delays, missed tasks, and avoidable operational issuesReportingTimely submission of weekly progress reportsProcess ImprovementImplementation of systems, checklists, and workflows that improve efficiency

Specific targets will be established during onboarding in consultation with the school leadership.

6. Working Style and Expectations

The Project Coordinator is expected to:

* Maintain a structured task list and daily priorities.
* Review deadlines and follow up with responsible team members.
* Flag risks and delays before they become major problems.
* Maintain clear written records of decisions and commitments.
* Provide a concise weekly report to the school leadership.
* Handle routine responsibilities independently while escalating important decisions appropriately.
* Maintain professional conduct and confidentiality at all times.
* Be comfortable working in a small, evolving educational institution where initiative and flexibility are essential.

7. What Success Looks Like

Within the first three months, the Project Coordinator should be able to:

* Establish a centralised system for tracking projects, tasks, schedules, and deadlines.
* Ensure that school calendars, academic activities, events, and parent communications are coordinated reliably.
* Maintain accurate and accessible administrative records.
* Introduce practical checklists and standard operating procedures for recurring activities.
* Establish a dependable weekly reporting and follow-up process.
* Demonstrate the ability to independently manage routine coordination while escalating critical issues appropriately.
* Help the school leadership spend less time on routine follow-ups and more time on educational quality, strategic priorities, and institutional growth.

8. Why Join Vidyāmṛt?

Vidyāmṛt offers an opportunity to contribute to an evolving educational model that seeks to combine academic excellence with character, creativity, innovation, and spiritual development.

The role is suited to someone who wants to do more than administrative work: someone who enjoys building systems, coordinating people, solving problems, and helping an educational vision translate into meaningful daily experiences for children.

*If you are organised, proactive, technology-enabled, and passionate about education, we invite you to be part of the Vidyāmṛt journey.*

About the Role

We are looking for a dynamic, target-oriented, and experienced *Business Development Officer (BDO)* with a strong background in the medical and healthcare industry to drive business growth for our Continuing Professional Development (CPD) courses.

The ideal candidate should have prior experience in business development, institutional sales, healthcare partnerships, or medical education, with a proven ability to generate business from hospitals, clinics, medical colleges, nursing colleges, pharmacy colleges, and other healthcare-related institutions.

This is a field-oriented business development role that requires regular visits to healthcare institutions, building relationships with key decision-makers, promoting our CPD training programmes, developing institutional partnerships, and converting business opportunities into confirmed enrolments and revenue.

*We are specifically looking for someone who knows how to bring business to the company, has experience in the medical sector, and can independently develop new institutional accounts.*

Key Responsibilities1. Business Development & Revenue Generation

* Identify and develop new business opportunities for CPD courses and healthcare-related training programmes.
* Generate qualified leads and convert them into paying institutional clients and course enrolments.
* Develop and execute business development strategies to achieve monthly and quarterly revenue targets.
* Build a strong pipeline of hospitals, clinics, colleges, and healthcare institutions.
* Negotiate commercial terms, training packages, and institutional enrolment opportunities.
* Take ownership of the complete business development cycle, from prospecting to deal closure.

2. Hospital & Healthcare Institution Visits

* Conduct regular field visits to hospitals, clinics, diagnostic centres, healthcare groups, and other medical institutions.
* Meet hospital administrators, medical superintendents, HR managers, training coordinators, nursing superintendents, and other relevant decision-makers.
* Present CPD courses and explain their relevance to doctors, nurses, pharmacists, nutrition professionals, and other healthcare practitioners.
* Explore opportunities for institutional training programmes, bulk enrolments, staff development initiatives, and recurring training partnerships.
* Maintain consistent follow-ups with prospective and existing institutional clients to convert opportunities into business.

3. Medical College & Educational Institution Partnerships

* Develop business relationships with:
* MBBS colleges and medical schools
* Nursing colleges and nursing schools
* B.Sc. Nutrition and Dietetics colleges
* Pharmacy colleges
* Allied health sciences and paramedical institutions
* Healthcare training institutes and professional associations
* Visit college management teams, principals, deans, heads of departments, placement officers, and faculty coordinators.

* Arrange institutional presentations, meetings, seminars, orientation sessions, and course awareness activities.
* Establish long-term partnerships with colleges and healthcare institutions to generate repeat business.

4. Institutional Sales & Partnership Development

* Pitch CPD programmes to hospitals, colleges, clinics, and healthcare organisations.
* Prepare proposals, quotations, presentations, and partnership offers for prospective clients.
* Explore bulk enrolment models, corporate training opportunities, institutional tie-ups, and customised training arrangements.
* Coordinate with internal teams to organise course demonstrations, information sessions, and enrolment drives.

description:
*Location:* Pune, Maharashtra
*Employment Type:* Full-time
*Program:* Lighthouse Kiran
*Reports To:* Senior Manager
*Travel Requirement:* Up to 70%
*Experience: 8+ years*

About Lighthouse Communities Foundation

Lighthouse Communities Foundation (LCF) works to create pathways to *education, skilling, employment, and sustainable livelihoods for underserved youth*.

Through a pioneering Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model, LCF brings together *Government, Corporates, NGOs, and Citizens* to create opportunities and enable socio-economic transformation.

Our Lighthouse centres are supported through partnerships with government and corporate CSR stakeholders, while NGOs bring expertise in education and skilling to create meaningful opportunities for young people.

With a strong presence across Pune and expansion across *PCMC, Dombivli, Aurangabad, Delhi, Odisha, Hyderabad, Thane, and other geographies*, we continue to build scalable models for youth development.

*Our core values:* Empathy | Inclusion | Integrity | Courage

*About Lighthouse Kiran*

*Lighthouse Kiran* focuses on helping adolescents develop the skills, confidence, and agency needed to make informed decisions about their education, personal development, and future livelihoods.

The program focuses strongly on *Social and Emotional Learning (SEL)* and aims to create learning environments where adolescents feel secure, supported, and empowered to take ownership of their learning.

Through SEL, teacher capacity building, improved learning environments, and stronger educational engagement, Lighthouse Kiran seeks to:

* Strengthen adolescents' core competencies and agency.
* Develop self-learning, creativity, and decision-making skills.
* Support positive academic and social development.
* Reduce school dropout rates.
* Improve students' preparedness for future education and livelihoods.

*About the Role*

We are looking for an experienced and purpose-driven *Manager – Quality Education* to lead the implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of the Lighthouse Kiran program.

The role will involve managing program implementation across *Pune, Pimpri Chinchwad, Hyderabad, Odisha, and Thane*, as well as supporting expansion into tribal locations and other geographies.

The ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in *education program management, Social Emotional Learning, teacher development, stakeholder engagement, impact measurement, and team leadership*.

The role requires the ability to work closely with schools, government departments, teachers, community stakeholders, donors, and internal teams to ensure high-quality implementation and measurable outcomes.

*Key Responsibilities*

1. Program Implementation & Monitoring

* Lead the implementation of Lighthouse Kiran across programme locations and partner institutions.
* Coordinate with field teams, schools, colleges, and institutional partners to ensure effective program delivery.
* Monitor learner participation, program quality, implementation progress, and intended outcomes.
* Strengthen engagement with adolescents, teachers, school leaders, and institutional stakeholders.
* Identify implementation challenges and develop timely solutions.
* Support the design and piloting of innovative interventions to strengthen program outcomes.

2. Impact Assessment, Monitoring & Learning

* Design and implement impact assessment and learning frameworks for Lighthouse Kiran.
* Collect, analyze, and interpret quantitative and qualitative program data.
* Track key program indicators and identify trends, gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
* Generate actionable insights and recommendations for continuous program improvement.
* Prepare impact reports and present findings to internal teams, donors, government stakeholders, and partners.

3. Teacher Capacity Building

Design, coordinate, and facilitate capacity-building initiatives for:

* Primary and secondary school teachers.
* Headmasters/Headmistresses.
* School leaders and other education stakeholders.

Key areas may include:

* Social Emotional Learning (SEL).
* Assessment for Learning.
* Positive School Climate.
* Adolescent development and well-being.
* Learner-centred teaching practices.

title: Preschool Teacher
description:
Overview of the Preschool Teacher role

A Preschool Teacher is responsible for creating a safe, nurturing, and stimulating environment for

young children. They plan and implement educational activities that promote cognitive, social,

emotional, and physical development while ensuring children's well-being and safety.

Job Title: Daycare Teacher

Role: Full-time/Onsite

Work Days: Monday to Saturday

Timings: 09:00 AM to 3:00 PM

Location: BENGALURU

Job Responsibilities:

Classroom Management

 Ensuring age-appropriate resources are labelled and accessible for use.

 Ensuring children records, teacher’s corner is updated with accurate information.

 Maintain a clean and safe environment, welcoming for children.

 Display boards and children’s work is always updated.

 Ensuring children bags and belongings are neatly stored away and mindfully packed

everyday for return to home.

 Ensuring meal and nap arrangement is led on time.

Learning Engagement

 Ensuring adherence to the daily schedules and routine of the children.

 Providing seven areas of learning environment as per EYFS curriculum for children.

 Follow the activity planner of Daycare.

 Ensuring children transition to different activities and learning spaces smoothly. Adapt

lessons to children's interests and learning styles.

 Adapt to children's moods and interests to keep them engaged.

 Help new children to settle swiftly following in the settling policy.

 Lead children to outdoor and indoor area play.

 Use creative ways of storytelling, play based learning, role play etc for learning

 Demonstrate kindness, patience, and active listening.

 Incorporate movement, music, and sensory activities.

 Foster confidence in children by planning hands-on and child led activities.

 Guide children with gentle expectations for correcting behaviour.

 Children coming from afterschool or children transitioning from morning to daycare should

blend smoothly by helping in changing uniform, meals and transitioning them to sleep or

daycare activities.

 Aid older daycare children incase of homework supervision.

 Prepare for special days and events as per the annual calendar.

 Provide attentive and nurturing care to children.

Communication with parents

 Provide an update of each child's day, including meals, naps, and activities daily.

 Use a parent communication app.

 Always be updated with child’s meal, care, nap, schedule requirements.

 Encourage parent Involvement in events and school initiatives.

 Be able to conduct parent-teacher meetings successfully by handling concerns professionally

 Address behavioural or developmental concerns with parents sensitively. Maintain a positive

and collaborative relationship with families. Communicate regularly with parents about their

child's development and progress.

Health & safety compliance

 Carrying out risk assessment for classrooms and keeping office informed for corrective

measures.

 Ensuring children are always in ratio of adult supervision.

 Child should always be attended by an adult.

 Always be informed about allergies and illness of the child and display information as

necessary for other team members who are responsible for care.

 Incidents should be reported in a timely and transparent manner.

 Keeping children in hygienic and safe conditions. Ensuring classrooms are naturally

ventilated during the day and is kept odour free.

 Ensuring children are served fresh and hygienic meals.

 Children are provided with clean dairy products and bottles for feeding.

 Children diapering and toileting needs attended promptly. Ensuring facilities are cleaned and

maintained by nannies.

Additional responsibilities

 Coordinate and participate in school events.

 Help in preparing centre displays.

 Provide substitute assistance in the absence of other team members.

Educational Qualifications:

 Graduation in any discipline.

 Degree in Early Childhood Education (preferred).

 First Aid and CPR Certification (optional)

Work Experience:

 Minimum 1-2 years of experience in a childcare care setting with young people.

Skills:

 Patient, nurturing and love for working with children.

 Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

 Mobile and social media savvy.

 Confident in using parent app.

 Be able to work on MS-office with basic skills for developing planner and schedules.

 Creativity and ability to prepare and design display boards and decorations.

 Strong organizational and time management skills.

Additional Information:

 Distance to workplace: 1 to 8 km.

 Flexibility: Ability to adapt to changing schedules and needs of children.

 Willing to move between different age groups of children ranging from infants to 10 years.

 Team Player: Work collaboratively with other teachers and staff.

 Physical Stamina: Ability to actively engage with children throughout the day.

 Maintain high discipline for attendance and timeliness.

title: Librarian
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a qualified and organized Librarian to manage the library’s day-to-day operations, maintain library resources, assist students/users in finding information, and promote effective use of library facilities and digital resources.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage the day-to-day operations of the library.
* Catalog, classify, label, and maintain books, journals, periodicals, and digital resources.
* Issue and return library materials and maintain accurate circulation records.
* Assist students, staff, and other users in locating books and information.
* Maintain and update the library database and records.
* Monitor new publications and recommend books and other resources for acquisition.
* Ensure books and library materials are properly arranged and maintained.
* Conduct periodic stock verification and maintain inventory records.
* Support users in accessing e-books, online databases, and other digital resources.
* Maintain a quiet, clean, safe, and welcoming library environment.
* Prepare reports related to library usage, circulation, inventory, and acquisitions.
* Coordinate library activities, reading programs, orientations, and awareness initiatives.
* Ensure compliance with library policies and procedures.

Qualifications

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Library Science / Library & Information Science (BLIS/MLIS) or equivalent.
* Relevant certification or professional qualification will be an advantage.
* Previous experience in a library, school, college, university, or corporate library is preferred.
* Good knowledge of library classification and cataloging systems.
* Familiarity with library management software and digital resources.

Skills & Competencies

* Strong organizational and record-keeping skills.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Customer/student-service orientation.
* Basic computer and digital literacy.
* Attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently.
* Knowledge of library automation systems.
* Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.

Experience

*Preferred:* 1–2 years of relevant experience, depending on the level of the position.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

Benefits:
* Food provided
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: School Librarian
description:
*Position Title:* Librarian

*Department:* Academics

*Reports To:* Principal

*Job Summary:*

The Librarian is responsible for managing the school library and ensuring students and staff have access to a well-organized and resourceful learning environment. The role includes maintaining library resources, encouraging reading habits among students, supporting academic activities, and managing library operations efficiently.

*Key Responsibilities:*

*Library Management*

* Organize, maintain, and manage library books, journals, magazines, and digital resources.
* Ensure proper cataloging, classification, and shelving of books and materials.
* Maintain records of issued and returned books.
* Monitor and update library inventory regularly.

*Student & Staff Support*

* Assist students and staff in locating and selecting appropriate learning resources.
* Promote reading habits and library usage among students.
* Guide students in research and information-gathering activities.
* Support teachers with academic and reference materials.

*Library Operations*

* Maintain discipline and a quiet learning environment in the library.
* Issue and collect books and ensure timely return of library materials.
* Prepare library reports and maintain usage records.
* Ensure proper care and maintenance of books and library equipment.

*Academic Support*

* Coordinate with teachers regarding curriculum-related resources.
* Organize reading programs, book fairs, storytelling sessions, and literary activities.
* Encourage participation in reading and language enrichment programs.

*Administrative Responsibilities*

* Recommend procurement of new books and learning materials.
* Ensure compliance with school library policies and procedures.
* Maintain digital records and library management systems where applicable.

*Qualifications:*

* Bachelor’s Degree in Library Science / Library & Information Science or relevant field.
* Master’s Degree in Library Science is preferred.
* Prior experience in a school or academic library is preferred.

*Skills Required:*

* Good organizational and record-keeping skills.
* Strong communication and interpersonal abilities.
* Knowledge of library management systems and MS Office.
* Ability to guide students and promote reading culture.
* Attention to detail and time management skills.

*Working Conditions:*

* Full-time position.
* School working hours as per institutional policy.

*Salary:*

As per school norms and candidate experience.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹45,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

title: Assistant Librarian
description:
Job Posting Date: 27 Oct 2026
Location:

Hyderabad, IN

Job ID: 10494
School: Oakridge International School Bachupally
Company: Nord Anglia Education

Nord Anglia Education is the world’s leading premium schools organization. Our family of 61 schools is united by a common philosophy - to be ambitious for our students, people and schools. We believe there is no limit to what our students can achieve and our approach supports every child to succeed academically, socially and personally. The India Region encompasses 5 schools across India.

Job Description

Providing high-quality library support services across the school, ensuring effective access to learning resources, fostering a culture of reading, research, information literacy, and supporting outstanding student outcomes.

Driving Library & Learning Resource excellence through effective library management, resource organization, student engagement programmes, literacy initiatives, and integration of digital learning resources.

Supporting student achievement, independent learning, research skills, and holistic development through library services, reading programmes, resource facilitation, and collaborative engagement with students, parents, and colleagues.

Providing academic and operational support in library administration, cataloguing, circulation management, resource procurement, student enrichment programmes, and continuous school improvement initiatives.

KEY RESULT AREAS :

Library Operations & Resource Management
Student Learning & Information Literacy Support
Reading Promotion & Library Programmes
Digital Resources & Research Support
Student Wellbeing & Library Engagement
Parent Partnership & Stakeholder Engagement
Faculty Collaboration & Professional Development
Innovation, Research & Digital Learning
Library Compliance & Administrative Operations

Find more details in the full JD: Assistant Librarian JD.docx

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

1. Library Operations & Resource Management
Support the day-to-day operations of the school library.
Assist in cataloguing, classification, and organization of library resources.
Maintain accurate records of issued, returned, and overdue materials.
2. Student Learning & Information Literacy Support
Assist students in locating and accessing learning resources.
Support the development of information literacy and research skills.
Guide students in the effective use of library resources and reference materials.
3. Reading Promotion & Library Programmes
Promote reading habits and lifelong learning among students.
Support reading initiatives, book fairs, and literacy programmes.
Assist in organizing library-related events and activities.
4. Digital Resources & Research Support
Support access to digital libraries, databases, and online learning resources.
Assist students and staff in utilizing digital research tools.
Promote ethical and responsible use of information resources.
5. Student Wellbeing & Library Engagement
Foster a welcoming, inclusive, and student-friendly library environment.
Encourage responsible library usage and positive student behaviour.
Support student wellbeing through engagement in reading and learning activities.
6. Parent Partnership & Stakeholder Engagement
Support communication regarding library programmes and initiatives.
Assist in promoting reading culture among students and parents.
Build positive relationships with stakeholders through library activities.
7. Faculty Collaboration & Professional Development
Collaborate with teachers to support curriculum-related resource requirements.
Assist faculty in identifying and accessing relevant learning materials.
Participate in professional development initiatives and library improvement programmes.
8. Innovation, Research & Digital Learning
Support innovative library practices and technology integration.
Assist in developing resource collections that support research and inquiry-based learning.
Encourage students to develop critical thinking and independent research skills.

REQUIRED SKILLS/ABILITIES
Bachelor's Degree in Library Science (B.Lib.Sc.) or Library & Information Science; Master's Degree preferred.
2+ years of experience in a school, academic, or institutional library setting.
Strong knowledge of library management practices, cataloguing systems, and information services.
Demonstrated expertise in managing library resources and supporting student learning.
Ability to promote reading habits and information literacy among students.
Experience working with library management software and digital learning resources.
Strong organizational and resource management skills.
Proficiency in educational technology and digital information platforms.
Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
Strong collaboration and stakeholder management capabilities.
Excellent organisational and time-management skills.
Professional, ethical, and student-centred approach to library services.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
Commitment to safeguarding, inclusion, student wellbeing, and continuous professional growth.
Ability to work collaboratively with academic leaders and contribute to school-wide improvement initiatives.

At Nord Anglia Education we are committed to providing a world class, safe, happy environment in which children and young people can thrive and learn. We are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of all our pupils where we embrace all race, abilities, religions, genders, and cultures.
All post holders in regulated activity (having regular unsupervised contact with children) are subject to appropriate national and international vetting procedures including satisfactory criminal record checks from both your country of residence/birth and any country of residence within the last 10 years.
We welcome applications from suitable qualified persons from all diverse backgrounds.
Please note, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
